items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: I met Charles Mingus out in Los Angeles when I went out there with Slim back in '39.

ctx.x: Do you recall when you met Charles Mingus?
Yes, I do. I met Charles Mingus out in Los Angeles when I went out there with Slim back in '39.
Oh, he was about 17 then, because he was born in 1922.
